question_en: An AI practitioner is using an Amazon Bedrock base model to summarize session chats from the customer service department. The AI practitioner wants to store invocation logs to monitor model input and output data. Which strategy should the AI practitioner use?

options_en.A: Configure AWS CloudTrail as the logs destination for the model.
options_en.B: Enable invocation logging in Amazon Bedrock.
options_en.C: Configure AWS Audit Manager as the logs destination for the model.
options_en.D: Configure model invocation logging in Amazon EventBridge.

options_cn.A: 将AWS CloudTrail配置为模型的日志存储目标。
options_cn.B: 在Amazon Bedrock中启用调用日志功能。
options_cn.C: 将AWS Audit Manager配置为模型的日志存储目标。
options_cn.D: 在Amazon EventBridge中配置模型调用日志。

question_en: A research company implemented a chatbot by using a foundation model (FM) from Amazon Bedrock. The chatbot searches for answers to questions from a large database of research papers. After multiple prompt engineering attempts, the company notices that the FM is performing poorly because of the complex scientific terms in the research papers. How can the company improve the performance of the chatbot?
question_cn: 某研究公司基于Amazon Bedrock的基础模型（FM）部署了聊天机器人，该机器人从大型研究论文数据库中检索问题答案。经过多次提示词工程优化后，公司发现由于论文中存在复杂科技术语，模型性能表现较差。公司如何能提升聊天机器人的性能？

options_en.A: Use few-shot prompting to define how the FM can answer the questions.
options_en.B: Use domain adaptation fine-tuning to adapt the FM to complex scientific terms.
options_en.C: Change the FM inference parameters.
options_en.D: Clean the research paper data to remove complex scientific terms.

options_cn.A: 使用少样本提示词技术定义基础模型的答题逻辑。
options_cn.B: 通过领域适配微调让基础模型适配复杂科技术语。
options_cn.C: 修改基础模型的推理参数。
options_cn.D: 清洗研究论文数据，剔除复杂科技术语。

question_en: A company wants to use a large language model (LLM) on Amazon Bedrock for sentiment analysis. The company needs the LLM to produce more consistent responses to the same input prompt. Which adjustment to an inference parameter should the company make to meet these requirements?
question_cn: 某公司希望在Amazon Bedrock上使用大语言模型（LLM）进行情感分析，且要求模型对相同输入提示词生成更一致的回复。公司应调整哪个推理参数来满足需求？

options_en.A: Decrease the temperature value.
options_en.B: Increase the temperature value
options_en.C: Decrease the length of output tokens.

options_cn.A: 降低温度参数值。
options_cn.B: 提高温度参数值。
options_cn.C: 减少输出令牌的长度。

question_en: A company wants to develop a large language model (LLM) application by using Amazon Bedrock and customer data that is uploaded to Amazon S3. The company's security policy states that each team can access data for only the team's own customers. Which solution will meet these requirements?
question_cn: 某公司希望结合Amazon Bedrock和上传至Amazon S3的客户数据开发大语言模型（LLM）应用，其安全策略规定每个团队仅能访问自身负责的客户数据。哪种解决方案能满足需求？

options_en.A: Create an Amazon Bedrock custom service role for each team that has access to only the team's customer data.
options_en.B: Create a custom service role that has Amazon S3 access. Ask teams to specify the customer name on each Amazon Bedrock request.
options_en.C: Redact personal data in Amazon S3. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow team access to customer data.
options_en.D: Create one Amazon Bedrock role that has full Amazon S3 access. Create IAM roles for each team that have access to only each team's customer folders.

options_cn.A: 为每个团队创建仅能访问自身客户数据的Amazon Bedrock自定义服务角色。
options_cn.B: 创建具备Amazon S3访问权限的自定义服务角色，要求各团队在每次Amazon Bedrock请求中指定客户名称。
options_cn.C: 对Amazon S3中的个人数据进行脱敏，更新S3存储桶策略以允许团队访问客户数据。
options_cn.D: 创建一个具备完整Amazon S3访问权限的Amazon Bedrock角色，再为每个团队创建仅能访问自身客户文件夹的IAM角色。

question_en: A medical company deployed a disease detection model on Amazon Bedrock. To comply with privacy policies, the company wants to prevent the model from including personal patient information in its responses. The company also wants to receive notification when policy violations occur Which solution meets these requirements?
question_cn: 某医疗公司在Amazon Bedrock上部署了疾病检测模型，为遵守隐私政策，需防止模型在回复中包含患者个人信息，同时希望在出现政策违规时收到通知。哪种解决方案能满足需求？

options_en.A: Use Amazon Macie to scan the model's output for sensitive data and set up alerts for potential violations.
options_en.B: Configure AWS CloudTrail to monitor the model's responses and create alerts for any detected personal information.
options_en.C: Use Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock to filter content. Set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms for notification of policy violations.
options_en.D: Implement Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to detect data drift and receive alerts when model quality degrades.

options_cn.A: 使用Amazon Macie扫描模型输出中的敏感数据，并为潜在违规设置警报。
options_cn.B: 配置AWS CloudTrail监控模型回复，对检测到的个人信息触发警报。
options_cn.C: 使用Amazon Bedrock内容防护机制过滤内容，同时配置Amazon CloudWatch警报以接收政策违规通知。
options_cn.D: 部署Amazon SageMaker模型监控工具检测数据漂移，并在模型质量下降时接收警报。

options_en.B: Amazon Personalize
options_en.C: Amazon Lex

options_cn.B: Amazon Personalize
options_cn.C: Amazon Lex

question_en: (多选题)An education provider is building a question and answer application that uses a generative AI model to explain complex concepts. The education provider wants to automatically change the style of the model response depending on who is asking the question. The education provider will give the model the age range of the user who has asked the question. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort? (Note: Original question has single correct answer in the bank, marked as multiple by error, adjusted to single here)
question_cn: 某教育机构正在构建问答应用，通过生成式AI模型解释复杂概念，希望能根据提问者自动调整模型回复风格，且会向模型传入提问用户的年龄范围。哪种解决方案能以最低的实现成本满足需求？

options_en.A: Fine tune the model by using additional training data that is representative of the various age ranges that the application will support.
options_en.B: Add a role description to the prompt context that instructs the model of the age range that the response should target.
options_en.C: Use chain-of-thought reasoning to deduce the correct style and complexity for a response suitable for that user.
options_en.D: Summarize the response text depending on the age of the user so that younger users receive shorter responses.

options_cn.A: 使用能代表应用所支持的各年龄段的额外训练数据微调模型。
options_cn.B: 在提示词上下文中添加角色描述，告知模型回复需适配的年龄范围。
options_cn.C: 使用思维链推理推导适合该用户的回复风格和复杂度。
options_cn.D: 根据用户年龄汇总回复文本，让低龄用户收到更简短的回复。

question_en: An AI practitioner trained a custom model on Amazon Bedrock by using a training dataset that contains confidential data. question_cn: 一名AI从业者使用包含机密数据的训练数据集在Amazon Bedrock上训练了自定义模型，希望确保该模型在推理时不会基于机密数据生成回复。从业者应如何防止模型输出涉及机密数据的内容？

question_en: What are tokens in the context of generative AI models?
question_cn: 在生成式AI模型的语境中，令牌指的是什么？

options_en.A: Tokens are the basic units of input and output that a generative AI model operates on, representing words, subwords, or other linguistic units.
options_en.B: Tokens are the mathematical representations of words or concepts used in generative AI models.
options_en.C: Tokens are the pre-trained weights of a generative AI model that are fine-tuned for specific tasks.
options_en.D: Tokens are the specific prompts or instructions given to a generative AI model to generate output.

options_cn.A: 令牌是生成式AI模型处理的输入输出基本单位，可表示单词、子词或其他语言单元。
options_cn.B: 令牌是生成式AI模型中用于表示单词或概念的数学向量。
options_cn.C: 令牌是生成式AI模型的预训练权重，可针对特定任务进行微调。
options_cn.D: 令牌是为生成式AI模型提供的、用于引导其生成输出的特定提示词或指令。
